npc_giovanni_smalltalk01: I will not tolerate your interference.
npc_giovanni_smalltalk02: You cannot stop me...but I’m amused by your attempt.
npc_giovanni_smalltalk03: Your professor has not prepared you for what is to come.
npc_giovanni_smalltalk04: You’ve made it this far. Let me see just how strong you are.
npc_giovanni_smalltalk05: Prepare yourself for a world of pain.
npc_giovanni_smalltalk06: Humble yourself. You are facing the world’s greatest Trainer.
npc_giovanni_smalltalk07: If you insist on disrupting my plans, I will insist on making you regret it.
npc_giovanni_smalltalk08: You have no idea who you are challenging, child.
npc_giovanni_smalltalk09: There is no stopping my plans.
npc_giovanni_smalltalk10: Two things are inevitable: my success and your failure.
npc_giovanni_smalltalk11: You have proven yourself by reaching me, so I shall spare you a moment of my time.
npc_giovanni_smalltalk12: You may have made it here, but this is as far as you’ll go.
npc_giovanni_smalltalk13: I’d say to prepare for battle, but you have already lost.
npc_giovanni_smalltalk14: I must say—I am impressed you got here.
npc_giovanni_smalltalk15: I am the leader of this enterprise...Giovanni!
npc_giovanni_smalltalk17: How dare you?! You will pay for your insolence!
npc_giovanni_smalltalk18: I commend you for standing up to me, Trainer. I trust you’ll make this worth my time.
npc_giovanni_smalltalk19: You are foolish to confront me, but I’m impressed by your confidence. Let’s battle.
npc_giovanni_smalltalk20: My goal is beyond your comprehension.
npc_giovanni_smalltalk21: If you insist on confronting me, you will pay the price!
npc_giovanni_smalltalk22: What’s this now? I hope you are a worthy opponent.
npc_sierra_smalltalk01: I envy you—you get to battle me!
npc_sierra_smalltalk02: This will be a battle I’m sure you’ll never forget.
npc_sierra_smalltalk03: You already know this, but you don’t stand a chance.
npc_sierra_smalltalk04: You can’t possibly match my skill, dear.
npc_sierra_smalltalk05: I do hope you like the taste of failure!
npc_sierra_smalltalk06: This is probably a waste of my time, but I do love winning!
npc_sierra_smalltalk07: I won’t be surprised when I win.
npc_sierra_smalltalk08: It will be good for you to see a true Trainer like me in battle.
npc_sierra_smalltalk09: If you are as weak as your team leaders, then this fight will be easy.
npc_sierra_smalltalk10: You should probably take notes, dear.
npc_sierra_smalltalk11: I’ll never pass up an opportunity to show off on the battlefield!
npc_sierra_smalltalk12: Can we move this along? I’d love to stay and chat, but I have a meeting to get to.
npc_sierra_smalltalk13: You shouldn’t get in my way. You might get hurt, dear.
npc_sierra_smalltalk14: This is a challenge you should walk away from, dear.
npc_sierra_smalltalk15: This won’t be all bad—when you lose, you’ll at least get to hear me say you made a good effort.
npc_sierra_smalltalk16: How amusing! You dare to challenge me?
npc_sierra_smalltalk17: Such an eager Trainer. I’ll happily defeat you.
npc_sierra_smalltalk18: Your inevitable loss will be such a good lesson.
npc_sierra_smalltalk19: Pay attention, Trainer. You just might learn something!
npc_sierra_smalltalk20: I’m getting tired of battling weaklings. Let’s get this over with.
npc_sierra_smalltalk21: Silly Trainer. You ought to know better than to oppose me.
npc_sierra_smalltalk22: You’ve had your fun. Now it’s time for you to fight me.
npc_sierra_smalltalk23: I can see this will be a struggle for you. Don’t worry. I’ll defeat you quickly.
npc_sierra_smalltalk24: It’s so cute how willing you are to accept your defeat. Let’s battle.
npc_sierra_smalltalk25: I’m not fond of dealing with weaklings. Pay attention! You might learn something.
npc_cliff_smalltalk01: I owe the boss my life. I’d do anything for him.
npc_cliff_smalltalk02: Add my name to your list of weaknesses.
npc_cliff_smalltalk04: You’re nothing more than a weak distraction.
npc_cliff_smalltalk05: I won’t let the boss down.
npc_cliff_smalltalk06: This’ll be a lesson you won’t soon forget.
npc_cliff_smalltalk07: This hero thing you’re trying? It’s about to come crashing down on you.
npc_cliff_smalltalk08: You’re a pest, and I’m gonna give you the boot.
npc_cliff_smalltalk09: Anyone who gets in my way gets destroyed.
npc_cliff_smalltalk10: My loyalty gives me strength. I won’t lose!
npc_cliff_smalltalk11: You? Defeat me? Not gonna happen.
npc_cliff_smalltalk12: Cliff’s my name. Battling’s my game.
npc_cliff_smalltalk15: You got a lot of nerve for a loser!
npc_cliff_smalltalk17: Do you think you can beat me?
npc_cliff_smalltalk18: The boss has ordered that we crush all of you, and the boss’s order is above all!
